integrity: The theorem follows from an exact gradient intertwining DQ=HD, the rational Crank–Nicolson functional calculus, strict resolvent diagonal decrease for a diagonally symmetrizable negative-definite Metzler edge matrix, and surjectivity of D. An exact rational checker verifies two opposite three-state phase separations. The gradient intertwining and the generic entrywise-positivity resolvent test are explicitly acknowledged as prior mathematics.
scientific_limitations: Exact arithmetic; finite irreducible birth-death generators on a totally ordered state space and Crank–Nicolson end steps. Adjacent-difference order preservation is distinct from nonnegative Markov transition entries. Three-state closed form only; general dimension uses uniquely characterized resolvent half-crossings. No nonlinear SSP, rounding, or general-poset result.
title: Sharp stochastic-order cutoff for Crank–Nicolson on finite birth–death chains
